description: Open a PabandiSession -- an "open tab" with a spending limit set by your Trust Score (800+ = $1000 / 30 days, 500+ = $100 / 7 days, below 500 = $20 / 24 hours). Call this before pabandi_execute_transaction; it returns the sessionId every subsequent spend uses. No wallet signature is needed.

ownerType.description: Which principal this tab belongs to

name: pabandi_open_session
